title: Strict transform preserves universally exact short exact sequences
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes and $\mathcal I\subset\mathcal O_S$ a finite-type quasi-coherent ideal. Let $b:S^b=\operatorname{Bl}_{\mathcal I}S\to S$ be its blowup [def-nagata-global-blowup]. Suppose $0\to\mathcal F_1\to\mathcal F_2\to\mathcal F_3\to0$ is a short exact sequence of quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-modules whose pullback to $X\times_ST$ remains exact for every morphism $T\to S$. Then the induced sequence of module strict transforms [def-trf-module-strict-transform] $0\to\mathcal F_1^b\to\mathcal F_2^b\to\mathcal F_3^b\to0$ on $X\times_SS^b$ is short exact. Pullback here means extension of scalars on module sheaves [def-pc-module-pullback].
